signals.content: Security guardrail proxy for AI agents. Intercepts and enforces policies on tool calls between users and LLM backends. Multi-tenant, fail-closed, 78+ prompt injection patterns, threat intel feeds, RBAC tool policies, output filtering, SIEM integration. Zero-LLM hot path, p95 < 40ms. Admin Portal included. signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; large language model relevance. Final score: 68. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: red-orbita/bulwark-gateway

A security‑guardrail proxy designed for AI agents. It sits between users and LLM backends, intercepting tool‑call requests and enforcing policies. Features include multi‑tenant isolation, fail‑closed operation, detection of 78+ prompt‑injection patterns, integration of threat‑intel feeds, RBAC‑based tool policies, output filtering, and SIEM forwarding. The data path avoids LLM processing (zero‑LLM hot path) with a 95th‑percentile latency under 40 ms. An admin portal provides configuration and monitoring, and the solution is Kubernetes‑native for cloud‑scale deployment.

العنوان: red-orbita/bulwark-gateway

وكيل أمان يعمل كحاجز للوكيل الذكي بين المستخدمين ونماذج اللغة الكبيرة. يعترض طلبات استدعاء الأدوات ويطبق سياسات الحماية. يدعم تعدد المستأجرين، وضع الفشل المغلق، اكتشاف أكثر من 78 نمط حقن موجه، دمج تغذيات استخبارات التهديدات، سياسات أدوات مبنية على التحكم بالوصول القائم على الأدوار، تصفية المخرجات، وإرسال سجلات إلى نظام SIEM. مسار البيانات لا يمر عبر نموذج لغة (zero‑LLM hot path) مع زمن استجابة 95٪ أقل من 40 مللي ثانية. يتضمن بوابة إدارية للتكوين والمراقبة، وهو مصمم للعمل على Kubernetes لتوفير قابلية التوسع السحابي.

signals.content: Orca multi-agent team room launcher + skill
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 58. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: tungnguyentu/orca-ai-team

Orca AI is a multi‑agent framework that launches a collaborative team room and provides a skill‑based interface. It enables autonomous agents to share context, coordinate tasks, and invoke specialized skills (e.g., data extraction, summarisation, web search). The system is open‑source, containerised for rapid deployment, and integrates with common LLM APIs. Current limitations include dependency on external model providers, limited fault‑tolerance for agent failures, and incomplete support for real‑time streaming data. Ongoing development focuses on improving orchestration robustness, expanding skill libraries, and adding secure authentication mechanisms.

Title: ramonlimaramos/synapto

Brief: Synapto is a persistent memory graph designed for AI coding agents. It combines semantic search, a knowledge graph, and time‑based decay mechanisms to manage information relevance on the MCP (Memory Control Plane). The architecture aims to improve code generation by retaining contextual relationships while automatically pruning outdated data. Current public information is limited to repository documentation and community discussions; performance claims remain unverified.
